question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the underlined word in the given sentence.

My family have heard a lot about the __clandestine__ transactions of Nishant’s family.
solution:
The correct answer is '**Overt**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The word "**clandestine**" means kept secret or done secretively, especially because illicit. (गुप्त)
 
• Its most appropriate antonym is "**Overt**," which means open or not secret. (प्रकट)
